cause_quote: The new shared-state owner added `stores.set(key, opening)`, retaining each successful worker handle until lifecycle cleanup even after its work finished.
user_saw: A request that needed a new SQLite store failed with “SQLite worker store capacity reached” when idle handles occupied the broker's available slots.
summary: The fix lets the SQLite broker reclaim a reservation from an owner-confirmed idle shared-state client before admitting a new store.
reasoning: The original broker already rejected opens when `this.clients.size >= MAX_STORES`, and the first shared-state worker cache retained idle handles without a way to release them under admission pressure. I checked the original broker and cache diffs and confirmed that the later idle timeout changes only affected how long handles stayed cached.
